name: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Disability Assistance
benefit: - One-time financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000/-. - Assistance is provided exclusively for the treatment of physical disability. > **NOTE:** Direct transfer to the beneficiary’s bank account.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a physically disabled artist or litterateur. 1. The applicant should be 21 years of age or above. 1. The applicant’s monthly income from all sources, including spouse income, should not exceed ₹10,000. 1. The total monthly family income, including dependents, should not exceed ₹20,000. > **NOTE:** Income limits are revised annually with a 6 percent increase for eligibility calculation.
